integrity: New claims are the complete number-of-nonzero-squares distributions, the isomorphism-class Burnside refinement, and the explicit conditional finite-basis density bound. The finite-basis criterion and unmarked semigroup counts belong to the cited earlier authors. Computational checks were finite; the general theorem uses exact counting arguments. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Counts only commutative finite nilpotency-index-three semigroups on a fixed labelled set or up to semigroup isomorphism. The density is conditional on this family, not universal for semigroups. No assertion of semiring isomorphism distinctions, sharp exceptional-density asymptotics, or bounds at higher nilpotency indices.
title: Square-marked census and finite-basis density for commutative three-nilpotent semigroups
